about: Tactical battle skills (base rows; the server adds one attack row per statue: SKILL_<first 3 digits of the statueId>_99, or its lowest SKILL_NN when the model has no ATTACK action, copied from JDR_ATK_00 with viewSkillId = the id so the client plays the statue's own attack action set). SKILL_000_01 (unit change) and SKILL_000_02 (cancel) are attached by the client to every unit and must exist; JDR_ATK_00 is the fallback attack. skillWait is how far a unit's action gauge drops after acting (100 for an attack, 50 for a unit change, 0 for cancel), so turns rotate. The attack category's first param is the hit attribute (PHYSICAL). Damage ranks index dtbattle_damage_rank_table (rate = 100 x rank in 1/10000): the attack is rank 100 (x1.0); normal skills 125, specials 150 (statues.json dtSkills). dtRangeMin/Max (cm) set where an attacker stops: Stand users 2-2.5 m and other melee 1.2-1.5 m in front of the target, bullet attackers 4-8 m, heals move only when the ally is over 10 m away (the client walks to the target's centre with 0/0). forceNormalCamera 1 on JDR_ATK_00 (and so on every attack row) keeps the whole attack on the client's own Overview two-shot: CreateSkillCommand (0xFB1728) turns script cameras off for the action, and the Overview camera follows the midpoint of the attacker and its targets from the world -Z side, so allies are on the left and enemies on the right, centred at any distance (docs/research/31 §8). Skill rows set it back to 0 so their script cameras play.
